Downtown Memphis.name: Downtown Memphis
Downtown Memphis.description: Mississippi riverfront civic core around Court Square and Beale with office-to-residential conversions and the densest 311 volume in the metro.

Harbor Town & Mud Island.name: Harbor Town & Mud Island
Harbor Town & Mud Island.description: Planned river-island neighborhood north of downtown with renovation-led permitting and trail-adjacent residential stock.

South Main.name: South Main
South Main.description: Arts-district warehouse conversions south of Beale with loft infill and entertainment-adjacent short-stay pressure.

Midtown & Cooper-Young.name: Midtown & Cooper-Young
Midtown & Cooper-Young.description: Streetcar-era bungalow grid and Cooper-Young commercial node with renovation-heavy residential permitting.

Medical District.name: Medical District
Medical District.description: Hospital-anchored employment core between downtown and Midtown with institutional expansion and workforce housing.

Overton Park & Evergreen.name: Overton Park & Evergreen
Overton Park & Evergreen.description: Park-adjacent historic district with conservation overlays and steady single-family renovation.

East Memphis.name: East Memphis
East Memphis.description: Poplar-corridor professional and residential belt with the metro's highest-value single-family stock and office parks.

Poplar Corridor.name: Poplar Corridor
Poplar Corridor.description: East-Poplar commercial spine toward Germantown with medical-office and multifamily infill.

Whitehaven.name: Whitehaven
Whitehaven.description: South-Memphis Graceland corridor with renovation and alteration permits on post-war tract housing.

South Memphis.name: South Memphis
South Memphis.description: Industrial-adjacent south grid with sparse new construction and high 311 volume relative to permit activity.

Frayser.name: Frayser
Frayser.description: North-Memphis residential plateau with alteration-led permitting and code-enforcement-heavy 311 demand.

Raleigh.name: Raleigh
Raleigh.description: Northeast Memphis / Raleigh Springs corridor with suburban-lot renovations and retail-node 311 volume.

University District.name: University District
University District.description: University of Memphis-adjacent rental and small-lot stock with student-driven turnover and renovation permits.

Hickory Hill & Parkway Village.name: Hickory Hill & Parkway Village
Hickory Hill & Parkway Village.description: Southeast Memphis suburban grid toward the Germantown line with townhome infill and solid-waste 311 load.
